accepted.sentence: On some models, a counterweight near the slide bow offsets its forward reach and improves balance in the hands.
A small lock ring on the brace can immobilize the moving section during carrying or storage.
Soft bumpers at the slide’s far end cushion accidental contact and help protect the tubes when fully extended.
The inner slide tubes have slightly enlarged lower sections, called stockings, that maintain a close fit inside the outer tubes.
Some modern designs accept interchangeable leadpipes, letting players change the narrow passage between the mouthpiece receiver and main tubing.
A threaded lock collar joins the slide receiver to the bell section, securing the parts while allowing them to separate for storage.
Bass models generally have a wider bore than tenor models, making the internal tubing diameter a notable difference between these forms.
At the far end of the moving section, a U-shaped bow reverses the airflow between its two parallel tubes.
